messages:
Maria H: Heads-up: we plan to cut over the new autoscaling policy to gpu-pool-dedicated-east at 16:30 PT today. Need someone to own smoke, someone to own rollback readiness.
Aj K: I can run the smoke checks — will do the perf & latency run at 16:40 PT and validate routing.
Devon: I'll be on rollback duty. I have the rollback playbook and previous config saved as `gpu-pool-dedicated-east-v12`. Ping me if anything >10% error or steady latency regression.
Sasha: PR landed and infra plan is in the PR description: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/4823 — autoscale policy change + burst tuning.
Lina: Quick question — will this trigger a proactive scale-up on cutover or only react to traffic?
Aj K: It will prime min_replicas to 3 during the 5m cutover window, so slight bump up. After that it follows target_utilization.
Maria H: Config snippet from the PR for quick visibility:
```
autoscaler: 
  target_utilization: 0.65
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 20
  cutover_min_replicas: 3  # applied for 5m after deploy
  burst_window_s: 30
  fallback_model: small-v1
```
Devon: Good. Make sure the fallback_model route is healthy — I just ran a quick healthcheck against small-v1 and it's OK.
Sasha: Note: we also changed eviction threshold to 0.75, see PR for rationale. Added an automated metric alert if queue length > 75 for 2m.
eng-oncall: I'll be watching alerts during and 30m after. If anything noisy, I'll mark the rollout paused.
Aj K: Smoke checklist (short):
  - verify service is serving on staging route
  - run 100 concurrent short requests and check p50/p95
  - validate KV cache priming not regressing cold-starts
  - confirm no rate-limit regressions
Please add any quick items.
Maria H: Also pinging @DevEx to ensure docs updated for the new min_replicas behavior (Lina can you follow up?).
Lina: Will update the runbook and add a note to console changelog after cutover.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Starting rollout for infra/pr-4823 to gpu-pool-dedicated-east at 2024-10-02T16:30:00Z.
Aj K: Smoke started. Running perf job now.
Aj K: Smoke results: p50 42ms, p95 210ms, error rate 0.2% — within expected bounds. KV priming looks fine.
Devon: Observability check: no queue spikes, CPU/GPU utilization within expected. Ready to proceed.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Rollout complete for infra/pr-4823 to gpu-pool-dedicated-east (canary -> 100%). No automated rollback triggered.
Maria H: Thanks everyone — closing the loop. Lina, please update runbook + docs when you have a minute.
Lina: On it, will push a small changelog entry and a short note in the runbook. :white_check_mark:
eng-oncall: I'll keep an eye until 17:00 PT and then sign off if stable.
